A Japanese IT agency in Tashkent

Qilich builds mobile apps, websites, Telegram bots, backend systems and AI integrations for businesses in Uzbekistan and for companies in Japan. The team works in Tashkent. This page is for anyone choosing a development partner: how we work, and the facts about the company.

How we work

  1. Plan first. We write down the screens, the data and the integrations before work starts, and agree them with you.
  2. A report every day. What was done, what comes next and where we need your answer, in writing, every day. In Japan this is called hōrensō: report, contact, consult.
  3. Nothing ships untested. Every version is tested before it goes live.
  4. After launch, too. We watch how people use the product and keep improving it, a little at a time. That is kaizen.

What we build

  • iOS and Android apps
  • Websites and web platforms
  • Telegram bots
  • Backend and integrations
  • Desktop apps
  • IoT
  • AI integration

Where we work

The team works in Tashkent (UTC+5). Tokyo is four hours ahead and five working hours overlap, so we work at the same time as our partners in Japan every day.

Why there is no portfolio

Qilich is new in Uzbekistan, so there is no portfolio here and no made-up numbers. Our first projects will be with you.
